entries.text: pole_ang_v strongly predicts action: negative -> push_left, positive -> push_right
evidence: tree root split pole_ang_v <= -0.025 separates 100% left vs mixed right
tree leaf n=1137 acc 100% left when pole_ang_v <= -0.079

entries.text: pole_angle also predicts: negative -> left, positive -> right when ang_v near zero
evidence: tree branch pole_ang_v > -0.025 and <=0.049 splits on pole_angle <= -0.001 vs >0.0

entries.text: cart_x and cart_v are relevant (0.97,0.98) suggesting full state linear controller, not just pole
policy is linear combination s = w_x*x + w_v*v + w_th*th + w_thd*thd + b, action = 1 if s>0 else 0
evidence: tree accuracy only 94.3% suggests linear boundary not axis-aligned
